Sixteen loaded bytes preceding the first routine at $0810. They remain part of the load image; an independent entry point or data consumer has not been established.

Store A at $0811 and return if $804A is zero. Otherwise call $083A to update the vertical offset and add it to $0811. If the offset at $0810 then equals zero, clear $804A and copy 40 bytes from $A07C to $4400 and 40 bytes from $A0A4 to $4428, in descending index order. Return.

If $804C is zero and $0810 is below $2A, increment $0810 and the five sprite Y operands at $8EFB, $8F2A, $8F3E, $8E8C and $8E78. If $804C is 2 and $0810 is nonzero, decrement the same six bytes. For any other $804C value leave them unchanged. Add $0810 to $0811 using byte arithmetic and return. The scroll-down boundary at $A14B sets $804A when its row pointer reaches $1000; the up and down input routines at $AE17 and $AE4B change $804C.

Outcome-screen interrupt tail installed by $0AF6: acknowledge VIC raster status, update sound through $E13A, and return through $8D69. The numbered airshaft load produces all eleven bytes. A VICE store trace caught six literal writes to $0891-$0896 at $054B, then five backward-match writes to $088C-$0890 at $059F. The match copies the already-decoded $0B14-$0B18 sequence. All eleven writes precede entry $8009; they are not inherited unexplained bytes.

Read CIA 1 port A bit 4 until it is high, then wait until it is low, and jump to the sound-state clear routine. Bit 4 is the active-low joystick-port-2 fire line; CIA port configuration can affect the read.
Single retained byte between the low-memory helper regions. An executed entry at this byte is not established.

Clear sound, start selection 2 and decrement attempts at $08CC. A nonzero result shows the remaining-attempt text, waits for fire and restarts at $8009. Zero shows the passage at $0A54, waits for fire and jumps to the transition at $AA4F.
One 120-byte, space-padded message passed to $0AF6 by the success path at $0897. It praises the player, says enough slime was collected to analyse, and asks for fire to continue.
One 120-byte, space-padded retry message passed to $0AF6 by $0ACC. The routine writes the remaining-chances digit into $09A0 and chooses the byte at $09AD before displaying the message.
One 120-byte, space-padded message passed to $0AF6 by $0AF2. It asks what kind of Ghostbuster would quit, then asks for fire.
One 120-byte, space-padded failure message passed to $0AF6 by $0AEB. It says not enough slime was collected, refers to Vigo, and asks for fire.

Encode the low three bits of $08CC as a digit at $09A0 and write a space at $09AD when $08CC equals 1, otherwise the text code $13. Display the 120-byte passage at $0964 through the shared outcome renderer.
Pass the passage pointer $0A54 in X/Y to the shared outcome renderer at $0AF6.
Pass the passage pointer $09DC in X/Y and fall through to the shared outcome renderer at $0AF6.

Save X and Y into the low and high bytes of the source operand at $0B5C, disable interrupts, install $088C at the interrupt vector, clear bit 7 of VIC control 1, stop CIA 1 timer A, acknowledge and enable the VIC interrupt, set the background to zero, and re-enable interrupts.
